script:
getgenv().G = true
getgenv().DamageMult = 100

local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Full Metal Kaiju Hunters",
    LoadingTitle = "Loading...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "",
    Theme = "Default",
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Combat", 4483362458)

local Events = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("Server")
local Combat = Events:WaitForChild("Combat")
local RangedCombat = Events:WaitForChild("RangedCombat")


spawn(function()
    while getgenv().G do
        local playerGui = game.Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if playerGui then
            local hud = playerGui:FindFirstChild("HUD")
            if hud then
                local energy = hud:FindFirstChild("Energy", true) or hud:FindFirstChild("Stats"):FindFirstChild("Energy")
                if energy and energy:IsA("NumberValue") or energy:IsA("IntValue") then
                    energy.Value = 999999
                end
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)


local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local old = mt.__namecall
setreadonly(mt, false)

mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local args = {...}
    local method = getnamecallmethod()

    if getgenv().G and (self == Combat or self == RangedCombat) and method == "FireServer" then
        if typeof(args[2]) == "table" then
            local t = args[2]
            t.Damage = (t.Damage or 100) * getgenv().DamageMult
            t.damage = (t.damage or 100) * getgenv().DamageMult
            t.Multiplier = (t.Multiplier or 1) * getgenv().DamageMult
            t.Power = (t.Power or 1) * getgenv().DamageMult
        end
    end

    return old(self, unpack(args))
end)

setreadonly(mt, true)

Tab:CreateSection("Damage")

Tab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Damage Multiplier (doesntwork)",
    Range = {1, 500},
    Increment = 10,
    CurrentValue = 100,
    Callback = function(v)
        getgenv().DamageMult = v
    end,
})

Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Spam Melee (Hold LMB)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        getgenv().SpamMelee = v
    end,
})

-- Melee Spam
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and getgenv().SpamMelee then
        getgenv().MeleeSpam = true
        while getgenv().MeleeSpam and getgenv().SpamMelee do
            Combat:FireServer("Melee", {Damage = 999999})
            task.wait(0.01)
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        getgenv().MeleeSpam = false
    end
end)

Tab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Kill All NPCs",
    Callback = function()
        for _, hum in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if hum:IsA("Humanoid") and not game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hum.Parent) then
                hum.Health = 0
            end
        end
    end,
})
